fusions.name: Bark Stripper
fusions.desc: A clawing swipe that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 5 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Sprawling Cuff
fusions.desc: Swings the full weight of the haft round you, dealing 15 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Autumn Stores
fusions.desc: Restores 18 health to you. The healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Cornered Bulk
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a ward worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
